Test fixture sources
====================

siv-mode-testcases.txt
  First 400 lines with 256-bit keys (and <= 8 associated data items) of
  src/test/resources/testcases.txt from https://github.com/cryptomator/siv-mode
  (Cryptomator's own AES-SIV implementation, used by cryptolib).
  Line format: ctrKey;macKey;plaintext;adCount;ad_1;...;ad_n;ciphertext (hex).
  License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2015-2017 Cryptomator.

vault-siv-gcm/
  tests/test-vault from https://github.com/ChrSchu90/CryptomatorVaultSync
  (unchanged). A format 8, SIV_GCM vault. The IMPORTANT.rtf file and the
  masterkey.cryptomator.*.bkup / vault.cryptomator.*.bkup files are what the
  Cryptomator desktop app writes when it creates a vault, so it was very
  likely created by Cryptomator itself. Password: cryptomator-vault-sync
  (from tests/test.sh of that repository).
  License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 ChrSchu.

vault-ctrmac-1/
  test/decryptionTest/vault1 from https://github.com/MangoCubes/cryptomator-ts
  (vault-valid.cryptomator renamed to vault.cryptomator; the 21 MB file
  d/OR/N6ES4UOUAYQQAJVCVOAEX623N6PBU5/O4oOlkPubcD-Z2wkofAKs-bQmqMznUo5ICdJcyBZWiINDUH7Ww==.c9r
  removed to keep the crate small). Format 8, SIV_CTRMAC. Contains the
  WELCOME.rtf the Cryptomator desktop app creates in new vaults.
  Password: qq11@@11.
  vault-corrupted.cryptomator is the same repository's tampered config.
vault-ctrmac-2/
  test/decryptionTest/vault2 from the same repository: format 8, SIV_CTRMAC,
  with shortened (.c9s) long names. Password: 12341234.
  License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 MangoCubes.

Known-answer values embedded in tests/reference_vectors.rs come from the unit
tests of https://github.com/cryptomator/cryptolib (v1 = SIV_CTRMAC, v2 = SIV_GCM,
MasterkeyFileAccessTest, ScryptTest) and RFC 7914.
